signal_generation.recent: exact H1 close at 09:00 on current rebalance Monday
signal_generation.anchor: exact H1 close at 09:00 on the preceding calendar month's first Monday
signal_generation.dollar_factor_return: equal-weight arithmetic mean of all seven foreign-currency log returns

direction.direct_mapping: foreign BUY=pair BUY, foreign SELL=pair SELL
direction.inverse_mapping: foreign BUY=pair SELL, foreign SELL=pair BUY

rebalance_entry_exit.target: first Monday of each calendar month at 10:05 broker-server time
rebalance_entry_exit.exit: close prior cohort before opening the new cohort
rebalance_entry_exit.final_cohort: must close at the next frozen rebalance before dataset end

commission_swap_friction.swap: frozen V26 FP Markets symbol specification

last_eligible_target_policy: target is eligible only when its unchanged next-first-Monday exit is before 2025-01-01
clean_segment_rule: one continuous broker history segment; missing any seven-symbol exact anchor or recent H1 close skips the whole cohort and invalidates V30 qualification
